text: 美股三大指数齐涨，纳指涨1.05%报27477.31点创收盘新高；AI芯片股与中概股普涨；金银期货双双在前一周大跌后企稳。 华为与高通达成多年期专利交叉授权，覆盖5G、计算、AI与网络等多领域，高通还将收购华为部分美国专利。 美国9月ISM服务业PMI降至54.9，但价格指数冲上74.0创四年新高，服务业扩张放缓的同时成本压力回升。 2026年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖揭晓，戴塞洛斯、黑格曼与纳格尔因光遗传学发现获奖，平分1200万瑞典克朗。 Meta、微软设法减少员工对Claude依赖：Meta内部使用人数减半，微软预算砍掉三分之一。 Spacex收涨7.6
text_en: The three major US stock indexes rose together, with the Nasdaq up 1.05% to 27,477.31 points, a record closing high; AI chip stocks and Chinese concept stocks rose broadly; gold and silver futures both stabilized after sharp declines the previous week. Huawei and Qualcomm reached a multi-year patent cross-licensing agreement covering 5G, computing, AI and networking among other areas, and Qualcomm will also acquire some of Huawei's US patents. The US September ISM services PMI fell to 54.9, but the prices index surged to 74.0, a four-year high, as services expansion slowed while cost pressures picked up again. The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was announced, with Deisseroth, Hegemann and Nagel winning for the discovery of optogenetics, sharing 12 million Swedish kronor. Meta and Microsoft seek to reduce employee reliance on Claude: Meta's internal usage halved, Microsoft cut its budget by one-third. SpaceX closed up 7.6
